patch.value: Mirror the fleet-wide changelog mode convergence: have the changelog-check recipe delegate to the replace-mode full render, and switch the release workflow CHANGELOG generate and check lines to --mode replace --all-release-tags. Release notes stay windowed to the new release.
Converge changelog generation and verification on replace mode
The release workflow regenerates CHANGELOG.md in prepend mode while the changelog gate verifies in replace mode, an unsatisfiable combination. Converge both on replace mode.
just changelog-check passes against a replace-mode CHANGELOG.md; cargo build, cargo test, and cargo clippy pass; the release workflow CHANGELOG generate and check lines use replace mode
